_readme: The marketing site's information architecture. sync.mjs builds the mega menu, More sheet, footer, breadcrumbs, related cards, home feature cards, the features.html directory and finder data, and the demo form's interest cards from this file. check.mjs verifies every features/<slug>.html has an entry (and vice versa), short <= 24 and line <= 40 characters, and that related, stage and pain slugs exist. Feature order is shop-day order.

groups.title: In the bay
groups.line: The board, inspections, diagnosis and parts.

groups.title: At the counter
groups.line: Estimates, invoices, payments and fleet accounts.

groups.title: Behind the desk
groups.line: Reports, payroll, QuickBooks and the AI assistant.

everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.line: The app itself, your data and the accounts it works with.

items.title: iPhone & iPad
items.blurb: Installs from the browser on iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and PC, opens full screen and keeps working when the internet drops.

items.title: Security & your data
items.blurb: Roles decide what each person can open. With Shop Cloud: two-step sign-in, change history and nightly backups.

items.title: Integrations
items.blurb: What Shop Cloud runs, and what each outside account turns on: Stripe, Twilio, Resend, QuickBooks Online, Smartcar and Anthropic.

features.title: Booking, check-in & front desk
features.blurb: Customers pick only times you have open. A key-drop check-in arrives as a new RO on your signed-in devices.
features.demoLabel: Open the calendar in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud for real open times, the booking inbox and remote check-in

features.title: Texting, calls & email
features.blurb: One thread per customer, from your own number.
features.demoLabel: Open messages in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud and your Twilio number; Resend for email

features.title: Customers & follow-ups
features.blurb: Oil-service reminders, declined work and win-backs from your own history.
features.demoLabel: Open follow-ups in the sample shop
features.needs: Optional: Shop Cloud with Twilio, Resend or Smartcar

features.title: Workflow board, Today & tech clock
features.line: Every car by stage, one-tap timers
features.blurb: Every car by stage. One-tap job timers.
features.demoLabel: Open the board in the sample shop
features.needs: Nothing extra (Shop Cloud to share the board)

features.title: Inspections & approvals
features.line: Photos, ratings and a yes by phone
features.blurb: 37 points, photos and a yes from their phone.
features.demoLabel: Open repair orders in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud for share links, online approvals and live status

features.title: Auto Diagnosis & vehicle data
features.blurb: Recalls, owner reports and your own fixes, ranked. VINs decode on the device.
features.demoLabel: Open Auto Diagnosis in the sample shop
features.needs: Internet for NHTSA lookups; Shop Cloud and your Anthropic key for the AI test plan

features.title: Parts, inventory & tires
features.line: Stock, POs, scanning, tire DOT log
features.blurb: On the shelf, on the job, on order. Scan it.
features.demoLabel: Open parts in the sample shop

features.title: Estimates, ROs & invoices
features.blurb: One record from estimate to paid receipt, with real PDFs.
features.demoLabel: Open repair orders in the sample shop

features.title: Payments & card readers
features.blurb: Pay links for the exact balance. Readers that know the amount.
features.demoLabel: Open repair orders in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud and your Stripe account

features.title: Fleet & business accounts
features.blurb: Terms, PM plans, statements and a portal.
features.demoLabel: Open accounts in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud for the fleet portal

features.title: Reports, payroll & QuickBooks
features.blurb: Your numbers, goals, payroll exports and a daily QuickBooks entry.
features.demoLabel: Open reports in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud and your own Intuit developer app for QuickBooks; Resend for the daily summary
features.note: Accounting, QuickBooks setup and payroll are owner-only.

features.title: AI assistant
features.line: Drafts to review and an AI receptionist
features.blurb: First drafts from Claude for your team to review, plus an AI receptionist for calls.
features.demoLabel: Open repair orders in the sample shop
features.needs: Shop Cloud and your Anthropic API key; your Twilio number for the receptionist
